speaker: abel_garnish
text: The book is the book, Master Will. The column is open. I will tick this afternoon, if there is anything to tick. I will not tick a hope.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tick nothing now. Two of the clock. We have the gown, the song, the pause, and the half-line. That is the morning's list, and it is short on purpose.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The gown is on me, sir. The sleeves cover the wrist. I will not show the boy under the Princess unless I lift my arm like a fool.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not lift it like a fool. Thou art from the first entrance to the last. Arthur is with thee for the Muscovites. Let them be known, and do not help them hide.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wilt not soften the end because a first yard is tender. I have Berowne in my mouth. He does not offer them a wedding they refused.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the refusal, Dick. The pause is where I marked it. If thou art kind at the last line, thou art in a different play.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And I am in this one, with a word still larger than the line. I will not promise you a blank afternoon. The groundlings never paid a penny to hear only what was set down. Today they are actually coming.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then let them come. What you add, Will, Garnish will see. I am not licensing it at nine in the morning, and I am not forbidding a yard I have not stood in.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have the pin. I have no stroke. Master Kemp, if you are a growing concern you may grow after two of the clock, in public, where I can count.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Slower in. Then nothing. I will not be funnier than a death. I have said so twice, and the third time is the playing.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam has the breath. I am not brushing the song again. Nick, your voice is sound. Spend it on the last scene, not on the morning.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I wait for the black before I answer. Dead for my life, and not over his line. Sir, the paper crown is on the stool. I have not touched it. It is yours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is mine, and it is paper, and it will do. Old velvet over it. I am not a better king than that this afternoon.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art Navarre enough. Do not tinker with the first line in the yard. Let fame do what fame does, and come off before you have improved it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not improve it in the yard. The line is the line. Two of the clock, and the Inns may come or not. Term is over. We do not send for them.

speaker: will_kemp
text: If they come, they will laugh at Berowne and then look for me. I can bear being second, for one afternoon, if the second is paid in noise.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Noise is not a column. A number is a thing I do not have yet. Do not hand me a number, Master Kemp, and do not hand me a nought dressed as modesty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No number. Abel, shut the margin until the play has been played. Dick, the refusal. Sincler, the nothing. Nick, the gown. I am going to look at the bill, and then I am going to put the crown on.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam will be left of the nail. If he is not, I will put him there with a hand, not with a speech. Go and look at your bill, Will. The song will not wander off.

speaker: john_sincler
text: I shall be black when you are paper. That is the whole of my courage, and it is enough.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Enough is the right size. Thou hast said the list. I have heard it. We will not have it a fourth time before two of the clock.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can turn in the gown. I did it yesterday. I will do it where they can see, and I will not look at my own sleeves while I speak.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then we are all very good, and very warned. I will see you on the trestles. Bring a yard, Master Shakespeare. I have brought the rest.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: One pass on the breath for Sam, and then I leave it. Luck is not a second singing.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I will be on the stool with the book. If a line is not in it, I shall know. That is the last thing I have to say before dinner, and I have said it.
